title: Weak X-Frame-Options (ALLOW-FROM) header value
description: The response sends X-Frame-Options: ALLOW-FROM. No current browser implements that directive: Chrome, Edge and Safari ignore the header value, so the response is framed without restriction unless a CSP frame-ancestors directive also applies. The header reads as a restriction while enforcing none.
remediation: Express the allowed embedder with Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors, and keep X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN for clients that predate CSP support.
limitation: Value check on one header value. It cannot see whether a CSP frame-ancestors directive also covers the response, and it does not test the framing result.
